# Pricing

The workspace price book: per-country (and per-carrier) sell prices in the workspace currency. For developers estimating cost before sending.

Back to the [API reference index](README.md). Shared shapes are in [Schemas](schemas.md); conventions (auth headers, errors, pagination, idempotency) are in the [index](README.md#conventions).

| Method | Path | Summary | Live example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/v1/pricing`](#get-v1pricing) | Get workspace effective price book | yes |

### GET /v1/pricing

**Get workspace effective price book**

Operation ID: `getPricing`. Tag: `Pricing`.

Effective sell prices per country, carrier and volume tier for the calling workspace. Precedence is workspace override, then country+carrier, then country, then the latest effective platform rule. absolute_price rows carry sell_amount; fixed/percent rows carry the markup rule only because the sell price needs the live provider cost at send time. converted_amount expresses absolute prices in the workspace currency via fx_rates and is null when no usable rate exists. Only pricing:read API keys or workspace sessions; prices from other workspaces are never returned.

**Auth:** API key with scope `pricing:read`, or session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |
| `product` | query | string | no | `"sms"` | One of: `sms`, `lookup`, `number_monthly`. |
| `country` | query | string | no |  | Two-letter ISO filter. Constraints: minLength `2`, maxLength `2`. |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Effective price book. | `application/json`: [PricingBook](schemas.md#pricingbook) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X GET "$OPENSMS_API/v1/pricing?country=KE" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_VG0...'
```
